reasons.plausibility: The proposed element-specific diffusion mechanism and inverse-radius melting trend are consistent with known high-entropy nanoparticle physics, though reliance on a single interatomic potential and assumptions about local energetic environments add minor uncertainties.
reasons.testability: They outline clear simulation metrics (mean-square displacement, pair-correlation functions, potential-energy curves) that can definitively confirm or refute the mechanisms and sequences of phase transformations.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a coherent framework for interpreting how size and element-specific diffusion influence melting in multicomponent nanoparticles, guiding both simulation and experimental validation strategies.
